context: As one of the members of a Web Application Development Team that consists of 3 or 4 students, you are assigned to design and develop a complete Web-based Learning System using .Net technology. The objective is to create a website that will serve as a platform for registered and non-registered users looking for digital learning resources, which refer to digital resources such as web applications that engage students in learning activities and support students' learning goals.

tasks.text: Develop a complete Web-based Learning System using .Net technology. The website must fulfill the following criteria: Consist of interlinked webpages; Contain proper examples of appropriate usage of the HTML5 elements; Demonstrate Cascading Stylesheet (CSS) usages; Provide good quality content; Demonstrate database connectivity to perform at least all the following operations: Insert new records, Display records, Update/ modify records, Delete records; Contain a registration page for new members; Contain registered member modules (require a valid login) to manage their activities; Contain administrator module (require a valid login) to manage the website content and database; Perform form validation; Provide appropriate navigation support; Perform proper file organization and naming convention.

Groups are required to submit a proposal report (Week 7) and a Final Report. The documentation should include: Table of Contents; Introduction/ Project Plan (objectives, scopes, and project schedule); Requirement Specification (audience modeling, use cases, flow charts, and major functions); Design and Modeling (ERD, Wireframes, and Website Navigational Structure with descriptions); Implementation (detailed explanation of source code of major features, CSS, form validation, and SQL queries); User Guidance (Screenshots with description); Conclusions; References; and Appendix.
